nodes.label: Stubbed ASR & Note-Generation Provider Interfaces
nodes.rationale: ElevenLabs Scribe and Luna/Haiku note-generation calls are stubbed behind provider interfaces (app/services/asr, app/services/note_generation) pending API keys and the Legal BAA/DPA question; swapping in a real call is a same-file change, not a redesign.

nodes.label: PHI_ENCRYPTION_KEY (Fernet)
nodes.rationale: App-level symmetric key generated via cryptography.fernet.Fernet, pasted into .env, used to encrypt PHI fields before storage.

nodes.label: Local Dev Port Collision Workaround
nodes.rationale: One host machine this was built on already had native Postgres/Redis installs squatting on standard ports, silently swallowing Docker's forwarded traffic, so docker-compose.yml publishes Postgres on 5433, Redis on 6380, MinIO on 9002/9003 instead of the defaults.

nodes.label: bcrypt==4.0.1 (pinned below 4.1)
nodes.rationale: passlib 1.7.4's self-test breaks against bcrypt>=4.1's stricter 72-byte check, so bcrypt is pinned to 4.0.1.

nodes.label: Expo Versioned-Docs Caution (v57.0.0)
nodes.rationale: Expo HAS CHANGED — read the exact versioned docs at docs.expo.dev/versions/v57.0.0 before writing any code, since Expo APIs move fast and generic/cached knowledge may be stale.

nodes.label: React Native (Expo) Mobile Client Decision
nodes.rationale: Web/PWA ruled out because mobile browsers suspend microphone capture on background/lock, conflicting with P0-2's interruption-survival requirement. React Native over two native codebases because a lean 4-8 week MVP team cannot maintain separate Swift and Kotlin apps.

nodes.label: Expo Custom Dev Client (CNG) Decision
nodes.rationale: Background audio capture needs native modules (background task registration, foreground service on Android, AVAudioSession background mode on iOS) that plain Expo managed workflow doesn't expose; a custom dev client keeps EAS Build/OTA while allowing native modules.

nodes.label: FastAPI Python Backend Decision
nodes.rationale: Backend is mostly I/O orchestration; every vendor (ElevenLabs, OpenAI-compatible note-gen, Anthropic fallback) ships a first-class Python SDK. FastAPI's free OpenAPI schema lets the RN client generate a typed API client, recovering the type-sharing benefit without forcing Python on mobile. Pydantic models double as validation for the note state machine and consent ledger schema.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database Decision
nodes.rationale: Data is relational by nature (patients, encounters, consent-ledger, notes, revisions, audit logs with real FKs). Postgres enum types enforce the note state machine at the DB layer; pgcrypto gives field-level PHI encryption without a separate KMS service; REVOKE UPDATE/DELETE plus an INSERT-only role gives an actually-enforced append-only consent ledger.

nodes.label: S3-Compatible Object Storage Decision (MinIO/S3)
nodes.rationale: Audio/transcripts are blobs, not rows; server-side encryption is separate from Postgres-level pgcrypto. MinIO locally is bit-for-bit API compatible with the prod S3-compatible bucket so no code branches on environment. Retention is a bucket lifecycle policy plus a retention_expires_at column, not a hardcoded TTL.

nodes.label: Celery + Redis Async Pipeline Decision
nodes.rationale: Transcription and note generation are slow, external, and retryable — Celery's use case. Redis is both the Celery broker and the patient fuzzy-match cache. The pipeline is a Celery chain (upload_finalized to transcribe to generate_note to notify_client) with an idempotency key stored as a unique constraint on the pipeline-run row, so a retried upload chunk resolves to the same run.

nodes.label: NoteGenerator Provider Interface Pattern
nodes.rationale: A small provider interface (NoteGenerator.generate(transcript) -> Note) with two implementations (Luna, Haiku) selected by a config flag makes the Claude Haiku 4.5 fallback a one-line config change instead of a code change, per the roadmap's own mitigation for the no-bake-off risk.

nodes.label: Auth & Security Baseline Decision
nodes.rationale: JWT access/refresh tokens with password + TOTP MFA (pyotp) instead of SMS OTP, since Remedy is not a telco and SMS delivery in the Philippines is a needless external dependency and cost. Role field checked via a FastAPI dependency on every route for need-to-know RBAC. A single audit_log table written by middleware, not scattered per-endpoint logging.

nodes.label: Monorepo Repo Layout Decision
nodes.rationale: A monorepo, not separate repos for mobile/api, because the two halves ship together at every milestone in the roadmap (Week 1 core pipeline, Week 2 identity+review+signing) — separate repos would add coordination overhead for a lean team with no other consumers of either half.

nodes.label: Accepted Risk: No Pre-Build Vendor Bake-off
nodes.rationale: The ASR + note-generation vendor bake-off was dropped because there's no practical way to source 25-30 consented test recordings. ElevenLabs Scribe v2 and GPT-5.6 Luna are committed to directly and validated during the build rather than before it. Mitigation: keep the note-generation model behind a config flag (Claude Haiku 4.5 fallback already designed) and treat Week 2 internal alpha as the first real-world test, watching edit-burden and doctor feedback from day one.
